protocol.purpose: Infrastructure retest, not training or statistical comparison
protocol.history: Empty isolated bank for each method; no feedback between methods
rules: One attempt per method, no paid retries
Identical public tests and limits; explicit uncalibrated priors
Typed responses, host-restored readonly files, synchronous public API; no source rewriting
MetaACO uses feasible initialization within 100 total evaluations
Shared remaining monetary budget changes per-attempt policy and may change available models
Held costs carry forward; missing accounting stops remaining series
Direct correctness and TDD compliance are reported separately
Preflight plans use total budget; actual manifests record remaining-budget plans; no manual route substitution

components.contract: Entry point and HTTP routing layer (fixed compatibility surface). Keep exports.version()===1 and exports.createApi(options={}) synchronous. createApi validates/derives options (sender, clock, secret, maxAttempts default 3, retryDelayMs default 100), constructs the state store, idempotency service, subscription service, and delivery worker, and returns {handle, runOnce}. handle({method,path,headers={},body}) must synchronously return a plain {status,body} object and never a Promise/thenable; it routes GET /health (200 {ok:true,version:1}), POST /subscriptions, POST /events, GET /events/:id (decode the :id segment), and returns 404 for unknown routes/methods. runOnce() is async and delegates to the delivery worker. This file owns HTTP status mapping and body shape only; it must not contain business logic or mutable data structures. Private interface expected from component b: createStore() returning store with subscriptions collection and events collection operations; createIdempotency/store key operations. Private interface expected from component c: services exposing createSubscription(input), ingestEvent(headers,body), getEventSnapshot(id), and worker.runOnce(). No shared mutable references may escape handle responses.

In-memory state and domain data store. Provides createStore({clock}) returning a store object that owns all mutable state and never aliases caller-provided objects or returned snapshots. Responsibilities: subscription registry keyed by id (validated {id,topic,url}); event registry keyed by event id and a separate idempotency-key registry mapping normalized key to {eventId, canonicalHash}; event records {id,topic,payload,deliveries} where each delivery is {subscriptionId,url,status,attempts,nextAttemptAt} with status one of pending/delivered/failed. Provides deep-clone-on-write and deep-clone-on-read using JSON-safe structural cloning (stable handling of nested objects/arrays so no shared mutable state is exposed). Provides canonical JSON serialization with recursively sorted object keys for idempotency equivalence comparison (array order preserved). Provides atomic claim semantics for the worker: tryClaimDueDelivery(now) that, under a single synchronous critical section (no await inside), selects at most one pending delivery whose nextAttemptAt <= now, marks it in-flight/claimed with a unique claim token so concurrent runOnce calls cannot select or send the same delivery, and returns a snapshot {eventId,subscriptionId,url,body,attempts,claimToken}; releaseClaim/settleClaim finalize outcomes. Guarantees no duplicate in-flight send of the same delivery while allowing different deliveries to be claimed independently. No persistence required. Expose helper validators for id/topic pattern /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$/, absolute http/https URL, and idempotency key (case-insensitive, nonblank, <=128 chars).

Business services: subscriptions, event ingestion, snapshot reads, and the signed-retry delivery worker. Exports createServices({store, sender, clock, secret, maxAttempts, retryDelayMs}) returning {createSubscription, ingestEvent, getEventSnapshot, runOnce}. createSubscription(input): validate id/topic/url; 201 {id} on creation, 409 duplicate id, 400 invalid. Capture nothing for past events. ingestEvent(headers,body): require case-insensitive Idempotency-Key (nonblank string <=128 chars); validate body {id,topic,payload} with id/topic pattern and payload a JSON object; invalid -> 400. If key seen with equivalent JSON (canonical, key-order-insensitive) -> 202 same event snapshot without new deliveries; different content under same key or same event id under a different key -> 409. On first accept, capture a deep snapshot of currently matching subscriptions and create deliveries {subscriptionId,url,status:'pending',attempts:0,nextAttemptAt:0}; return 202 with isolated event snapshot including deliveries. getEventSnapshot(id): deep-cloned 200 snapshot or 404. Delivery body is exactly JSON.stringify({id,topic,payload}); headers content-type application/json and x-signature-sha256 = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of those exact bytes with secret (use Node crypto). runOnce(): atomically claim at most one due pending delivery via store; if none return false; increment attempts for the attempted send; call sender({url,body,headers}) and treat HTTP 200-299 as success -> status delivered; exception or non-2xx -> status failed. On failure, if attempts >= maxAttempts set status failed (terminal), else keep pending with nextAttemptAt = clock() (time of attempted send) + retryDelayMs. Release/settle claim in finally so no delivery stays stuck; return true whenever an attempt occurred. Delivered/permanently failed deliveries never re-sent; concurrent runOnce calls cannot send the same delivery simultaneously. Must not mutate inputs or returned snapshots and must not leak store references.
